ContextTier

Context-aware dynamic data tiering for AI training. This self-contained page is generated from the project's result files and works without Streamlit.

960 matrix runs540 sweep runs20 configured seedsengine: virtual
This is a laptop-scale CPU emulation with scaled-down tiers, not a production storage stack. We re-implement seed-based exact prefetching and call it NoPFS-style; we do not run the original NoPFS code. All numbers on this site are read from the project's own result files.

Generated by build_site.py from results/ · This is a laptop-scale CPU emulation with scaled-down tiers, not a production storage stack. We re-implement seed-based exact prefetching and call it NoPFS-style; we do not run the original NoPFS code. All numbers on this site are read from the project's own result files. fast_hit is arrival-time residency, not post-promotion service tier. compute_ms is the measured median of 200 real TinyCNN CPU steps on this machine, not a placeholder. clairvoyant and belady are oracle upper bounds; Scenario C withholds the seeded oracle from clairvoyant. context_rules receives constructor-injected declared types; context_rules_noctx is its empty-map ablation. Learned models are trained once on their declared splits and are NOT retrained at each sweep point; sweeps measure transfer under shift. Scenario D is excluded from the capacity sweep because run_simulation forces its fast tier large enough to hold every file. All results come from the user's own runs; no numbers are illustrative or invented. All plotted values come from the user's Phase 8 runs; no numbers are invented. Error bars are the sample std over the configured seeds; the ablation and gain figures use paired per-seed differences. compute_gain draws the measured CPU step median read from results/real/step_time_benchmark.json; no value is hard-coded. Oracle and declared-type policies are labeled as such in every figure legend or axis. The all-policies figure uses a symlog x-axis because AllSlow and Scenario D differ by orders of magnitude.
